Handover checklist

Do not document everything. Record what someone needs to work independently.

Find the authoritative version

Where are the authoritative data, schema, guide and scripts? How are compatible versions identified?

Follow the workflow

Which tools and settings are needed? Which command works from a fresh copy?

Check and approve

Which automatic checks run, what editorial review is required and who may approve?

Understand changes

What has changed since the guide was written? Are justified exceptions still valid? Ask the people responsible today.

Pass on knowledge

Who maintains the guide? When is it reviewed? Is there a substitute and a channel for newcomers’ questions?

Done when …

Another person can find and follow the current workflow and knows where to direct a specific question.
